title: When Ecological Representations Stop Travelling
editorial_rule: Repositories own evidence and proofs; dissertation chapters and papers are organized by scientific question, not one repository per chapter.

chapters.title: 再利用問題
chapters.question: When may a representation adequate for one scientific responsibility be reused after the responsibility changes?

chapters.title: 生態遺伝状態は、何を予測するための状態か
chapters.question: Can one eco-genetic representation simultaneously stand in for potential viability, realised occupancy, transition dynamics, and predictive warning?
source_components: former chapter 4: state separation and common-scalar condition
state-validity: coarse marginals versus next-transition sufficiency and propagation
headline_chain: one common monotone sufficient scalar exists iff target vectors form a product-order chain
coarse marginal equality can coexist with different exact next transitions and a horizon-dependent downstream loss-risk contrast
perfect event-conditioned precedence fixes sensitivity but leaves specificity free; frozen full-denominator audits attain specificity 0 and binary AUC 0.5
shared_preconditions: state-validity and warning-validity reuse frozen model/event contracts from their source programme
warning event/non-event labels are imported from source-frozen contracts rather than derived from the common-scalar theorem
forbidden_dependency_claims: state separation theorem implies warning failure
warning failure validates the common-scalar theorem
natural-data four-gate programme validates the finite eco-genetic closure

standalone_paper.default_strategy: integrate EGC state separation, state-validity transition/propagation, and warning-validity denominator result into one domain theory paper before pursuing separate source manuscripts
standalone_paper.fallback_policy: retain for provenance and contingency; do not submit all by default

chapters.title: 未来が変わると、必要な状態も変わる
chapters.question: When does a previously adequate ecological state cease to be adequate after future actions, structural history, retained mechanisms, or evidential responsibilities change?
source_components: CREST world/contract-relative state definition and capacity-knowledge no-bound theorem
MLTR structural replacement and history coherence
MRM retained-mechanism response obstruction and active discrimination

dependency_graph.root: temporally extended ecological worlds plus declared scientific contract
dependency_graph.state_construction: CREST minimal adequate finite state / quotient
dependency_graph.note: CCOC, MLTR and MRM are parallel reasons a present-state merge can fail; they are not a linear theorem chain. CED is downstream because it asks whether evidence identifies a distinction already required by the task.

hard_dependencies: CED licensing presupposes a declared target/required distinction; it does not create the underlying ecological distinction
non_dependencies: CREST no-bound theorem does not require CCOC, MLTR or MRM proofs
CCOC, MLTR and MRM do not prove one another
the ecological worked bridges do not prove the finite CREST theorems

standalone_paper.working_title: When Conservation Capacity Outgrows Conservation Knowledge: A Contract-Relative Theory of Ecological State
main_text_priority: three parallel obstruction classes: future, history/structure, mechanism
evidence licensing as the final scientific gate
supplement_priority: MLTR full repair and route proofs
standalone_paper.fallback_policy: do not default to separate CCOC/MLTR/MRM/CED submissions while the integrated flagship remains coherent

chapters.title: 必要な区別を、どう観測で回収するか
chapters.question: Given unresolved mechanism distinctions, what can the current observation map identify in principle and which observation should be acquired next?
vertical_handoff: Boundary asks whether a proposed observation can reduce structural ambiguity at all
MROD starts from a declared admissible mechanism region and ranks verified candidate measurements by current information value
non_dependencies: MROD does not mathematically require the multiplicative Boundary model
Boundary does not require MROD's synthetic benchmark
the connection is a design handoff rather than a proof dependency

standalone_paper.working_title: From Identifiability Limits to Mechanism-Resolving Observation Design
standalone_paper.default_strategy: use the Boundary rank criterion and field-like witness as the structural-identification theory layer of the MROD methods paper rather than defaulting to a separate Perspective
standalone_paper.fallback_policy: retain both as contingency assets until the integrated manuscript passes journal-format and length review

chapters.title: 総合 — 妥当性に特権的な方向はない
chapters.english_title: Synthesis — Adequacy Has No Privileged Direction
chapters.question: What remains invariant across the three research series without collapsing their distinct scientific responsibilities into one richness axis?

legacy_research_partition_rule: The eight legacy research units chapter:1 through chapter:8 must appear exactly once across the three integrated research chapters.
dissertation_vertical_logic: Eco-genetic series demonstrates that representation adequacy changes with the ecological responsibility even inside one declared model family.
CREST generalizes why required state changes when futures, structures, mechanisms, or reporting responsibilities change.
Observation-design series asks what current measurements can identify and how to acquire the next distinction efficiently.
The synthesis treats these as typed responsibilities, not one monotone hierarchy of information or complexity.

cross_series_handoffs.claim_ceiling: Eco-genetic results motivate and instantiate state-adequacy problems; they do not prove CREST.
CREST specifies what distinctions a task may require; current MROD resolves declared mechanism ambiguity and is not yet a general target-conditioned CREST optimizer.

submission_policy.principle: Prefer a small number of coherent high-value papers; source-repository manuscripts and bundles are provenance/fallback assets rather than automatic submission obligations.
preferred_primary_papers: Boundary plus MROD integrated methods paper
submission_policy.conditional_third_paper: Eco-genetic integrated domain theory paper if it remains too large or ecologically specific to serve as the worked empirical/model layer of the CREST flagship.
not_default: separate CCOC, MLTR, MRM and CED submissions
automatic submission of warning, state-validity and EGC as three independent papers
